what: F1: Plan writes larch-log breadcrumbs from the wrong directory
scenario_or_breakage: Runtime streams are created under $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs, but larch-log commit only reads $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-logs/<skill>/<run_id>; walking $RUN_DIR/breadcrumbs will miss real breadcrumb files, so accepted durable breadcrumb logging silently produces no committed breadcrumbs
suggested_fix: Add an explicit bridge: either create LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM under the larch-log run dir from the launch snippets, or teach larch-log commit the session tmpdir breadcrumb source; update test-larch-log to use the real $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs plus --log-root "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-logs" layout

what: F2: Existing broad commit copy can carry raw breadcrumbs before redaction
scenario_or_breakage: If breadcrumbs are placed under the larch-log run dir as the plan describes, cp -rp "$src_path/." "$repo_path/" copies breadcrumbs/ raw into larch-logs before the proposed redaction step unless copy semantics are changed; a later redacted overwrite does not satisfy fail-closed on redactor failure or stale files
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to exclude breadcrumbs/ from the broad copy, stage redacted breadcrumbs in a temp directory, remove any stale repo breadcrumbs only after redaction succeeds, then atomically publish; add a test that redactor failure leaves no larch-logs/<run-id>/breadcrumbs directory or staged raw files

what: F3: Breadcrumb commit redaction omits tmpdir-path redaction
scenario_or_breakage: The plan pipes committed breadcrumbs only through redact-secrets.sh --streaming, but the committed run-log contract says session-derived content passes through both secrets and tmpdir-path redaction; breadcrumb text can include operator/session paths and would leak them
suggested_fix: Add redact-tmpdir-paths.sh to the breadcrumb commit pipeline before streaming secret redaction, preserve fail-closed behavior across both filters, and extend test-larch-log with a tmpdir path assertion in committed breadcrumbs

what: F4: Category migration misses a stream-inherited emit_breadcrumb callsite
scenario_or_breakage: dispatch-plan-voters.sh runs under LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM in the design plan-review flow and sources lib-voter-parse-rate.sh; its parse-rate retry breadcrumb lacks --category, so lib-quiet will emit WARN unknown-category=<missing> and drop that progress record
suggested_fix: Include scripts/lib-voter-parse-rate.sh in the stream-relevant category migration, categorize the retry-preserved message as retry or progress, and add a dispatch-plan-voters or lib-voter-parse-rate stream-set assertion that no missing-category warning is produced

what: F5: Path-scope plan does not cover RESEARCH_TMPDIR even though research uses breadcrumb-monitor
scenario_or_breakage: The monitor currently accepts IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, DESIGN_TMPDIR, and REVIEW_TMPDIR only, while research-phase launches collect-agent-results with streams under RESEARCH_TMPDIR; the plan adds path-scope rejection tests but no allowance or migration for this live background+monitor path
suggested_fix: Add RESEARCH_TMPDIR to the allowed session roots or move research breadcrumb streams under an accepted root, then add positive and rejection tests covering research streams so collect-agent-results remains completion-coupled in /research
